response.original_title: Disney+ Insider: Shanghai Disney Resort - 10th Anniversary Celebration
response.overview: Celebrate ten years of wonder at Shanghai Disney Resort through an unforgettable day of magic, joy, and connection with Disney+ Insider. Joined by beloved voice talent Zhang Zhen and Ji Guan-Lin, the journey takes viewers across the resort’s biggest anniversary experiences — from the breathtaking castle show The Heart of Magic to the lively FriendSHIP! pre-parade, and the debut of Zootopia in Mickey’s Storybook Express. Along the way, behind-the-scenes insights reveal the creativity shaping this milestone celebration. As the day builds to the emotional nighttime spectacular, Magic Together, the story highlights what makes this resort so special: the memories, friendships, and shared moments that bring the magic to life.
response.tagline: A joyful celebration of ten years of magic, memories, and connection at Shanghai Disney Resort.
response.title: Disney+ Insider: Shanghai Disney Resort - 10th Anniversary Celebration
